Irshad Muhammed vs Kerala State Civil Supplies ... on 16
February, 2024 
Author: Devan Ramachandran Bench: Devan Ramachandran  IN THE HIGH COURT OF KERALA AT ERNAKULAM  PRESENT  THE HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DEVAN RAMACHANDRAN  FRIDAY, THE 16TH DAY OF FEBRUARY 2024 / 27TH MAGHA, 1945  W.P.(C ) NO.21002 OF 2020 PETITIONER: 
 IRSHAD MUHAMMED,
 AGED 31 YEARS,
 CHEEPPALLI PADINJATTATHIL,
 KUREEPUZHA, KAVANAD,
 KOLLAM-691 003. 
 BY ADVS.
 K.I.MAYANKUTTY MATHER  KUM.NARAYANI HARIKRISHNAN RESPONDENTS:
 1 KERALA STATE CIVIL SUPPLIES CORPORATION LTD.,
 REPRESENTED BY ITS MANAGING DIRECTOR,
 MAVELI BHAVAN, GANDHI NAGAR,
 P.B. NO.2030, KADAVANTHRA P.O.,
 ERNAKULAM-682 020.
 2 THE GENERAL MANAGER,
 KERALA STATE CIVIL SUPPLIES CORPORATION LTD.,
 MAVELI BHAVAN, GANDHI NAGAR, P. B. NO.2030,
 KADAVANTHRA P.O., ERNAKULAM-682 020.
 3 THE MANAGER (NATIONAL FOOD SAFETY ACT),
 KERALA STATE CIVIL SUPPLIES CORPORATION LTD.,
 MAVELI BHAVAN, GANDHI NAGAR, P.B. NO.2030,
 KADAVANTHRA P.O., ERNAKULAM-682 020.
 4 THE REGIONAL MANAGER,
 KERALA STATE CIVIL SUPPLIES CORPORATION LTD.(SUPPLYCO),
 OPP. YATHRI NIVAS, NEAR GOVERNMENT GUEST HOUSE,
 PRS ROAD, THAIKKAD P. O.,
 THIRUVANANTHAPURAM-695 014.

 KERALA STATE CIVIL SUPPLIES CORPORATION LTD.(SUPPLYCO),
 PATHANAPURAM P.O., KOLLAM-691 001. 
 :2:
W.P.(C) No.21002 of 2020  6 SNK TRANSPORTING COMPANY  REPRESENTED BY ITS PARTNER - M. H. ABDUL SALIM,
 PATTALATHUPALLY PURAYIDOM, NEAR FCI,
 PATHANAPURAM P.O., KOLLAM-691 001.
 SMT.MOLLY JACOB, STANDING COUNSEL, SUPPLYCO  SRI.S.B.PREMACHANDRA PRABHU  THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 16.02.2024, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 :3:
W.P.(C) No.21002 of 2020  JUDGMENT Dated this the 16th day of February, 2024 When this matter was called, the learned Standing Counsel for the respondents submitted that the period of the tender has expired; and therefore, that the prayers in the writ petition have become infructuous. 
The learned counsel for the petitioner sought a day's time to confer with his client; but since the afore submission has been made by the responsible counsel of this Court, I see no reason to disbelieve him. 
I therefore close this writ petition finding it to have become infructuous, however, leaving liberty to the petitioner to seek rehearing, if it is found necessary. 
Sd/-
DEVAN RAMACHANDRAN JUDGE bpr APPENDIX OF WP(C) 21002/2020 PETITIONER'S EXHIBITS EXHIBIT P1 TRUE COPY OF THE NOTICE INVITING TENDER. 
EXHIBIT P1(A) TRUE COPY OF THE CORRIGENDUM NOTIFICATION. 
EXHIBIT P2 TRUE COPY OF THE TECHNICAL BID SUBMITTED BY THE 6TH RESPONDENT FOR PATHANAPURAM TALUK ALONG WITH AFFIDAVIT. 
EXHIBIT P3 TRUE COPY OF THE RESULT OF THE PRICE BID UPLOADED IN THE SITE OF SUPPLYCO. EXHIBIT P4 TRUE COPY OF THE COMPLAINT SUBMITTED BY THE PETITIONER BEFORE THE 1ST RESPONDENT.
